【Quality Bamboo Wood】Made of natural bamboo material, durable and can be served for a long time.

【Perfect Ash Catcher】Incense holder or ash catcher are long enough to catch all the ash so that it creates no mess and easy to empty and clean. This incense stick holder is light in weight,make it portable and easy to carry in your bag.

【Relaxing yourself】light up your favorite incense sticks and create your own personal aroma,positive energy is released in your room which helps you to relieve stress and anxiety,the soothing scents will promote relaxation and peace.

【Great gift】It is a perfect gift for housewarmings or gifting your friends & family who are into meditation or yoga.Nice to be placed in office, bathroom, bedroom, kitchen, garden, religious temple, beauty salon, yoga room, tea room, study room and more occasions.
